integrity: One classification/count with an explicit algebraic proof and finite regression checks; no independent mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes finite abelian G, automorphisms phi and 1-phi, coefficient field F_q with characteristic coprime to |G|. Closed midpoint formula assumes odd G. The count is via integer Smith forms, not a uniform elementary closed polynomial. Equivalence to an unindexed monomial-character lattice result remains a bibliographic risk; available abstract of arXiv:2609.03799 does not resolve full-text coverage.
title: Finite-field idempotents of connected Alexander quandle algebras via orbit lattices
